title: Sum of Increasing Product Blocks
summary: Given an integer n, calculate the sum of the first n blocks where the i-th block is the product of the next i consecutive integers, and return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given an integer n, calculate the sum of the first n blocks where the i-th block is the product of the next i consecutive integers, and return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Block i multiplies the next i unused positive integers.
Return the sum of the first n block products modulo 1,000,000,007.
reference_solution:
def sum_increasing_product_blocks(n):
    mod=1000000007;answer=0;next_value=1
    for size in range(1,n+1):
        product=1
        for value in range(next_value,next_value+size):product=product*value%mod
        answer=(answer+product)%mod;next_value+=size
    return answer

hints: The blocks partition the positive integers into lengths one, two, three, and so on.
Maintain the first unused integer and multiply exactly the next block length values.
Add each modular product and advance the first unused integer by the block length.
This visits every required factor once in its unique block and modular reduction preserves the final remainder.
